First, gifts from Anthropic’s employees and PAC.

What puts a member in the count

I · The arrival

Anthropic employee and PAC gifts reached 10 of today’s members by the end of 2024 and 201 by September 2026.

Anthropic employees gave $6.0M of their own money, 92% of it in 2026. Anthropic’s political action committee (PAC) gave $232K.

FEC contributions to campaigns, leadership PACs and single-member joint fundraising committees linked to serving members.

Employer is as the giver reported it to the FEC, including misspellings and entries in the occupation box. The amounts are gross contributions before refunds. The record runs through Sept. 30, 2026.

Anthropic announced $40.0M for Public First Action, a political nonprofit.Who gave across the wider network in earlier years? 1 slide →

Employee and PAC gifts

$6.2M across 1,068 employee gifts and 98 PAC gifts through Sept. 30, 2026. The PAC gave to committees linked to 90 of the 201 members, including 18 with no employee gift on file. The PAC’s first gift on record to a member now serving was on June 23, 2026. Each gridline on the first chart is ten times the level below. Givers who share a first name and surname count as one. Totals are gifts to committees linked to sitting members.

II · The bigger money

Anthropic announced $40.0M for a nonprofit. It gave $500K to a PAC that had already made most of its payments against Seth Moulton.

Commonwealth Together PAC reported the receipt from Public First Action on Aug. 3, 2026, after $1.6M of its $2.2M in payments against Moulton.

Sources · Anthropic’s announcement pages and the PAC’s FEC filings

The filings leave donor gifts unlinked to specific expenditures.

Before and after the nonprofit’s payment

Commonwealth Together PAC reported these payments as independent expenditures: outside election spending it reported on its own FEC filings. Anthropic announced its $40.0M for Public First Action on Feb. 12 and July 21, 2026.
